title: Agentic Delivery Framework: the pain and the solution
subtitle: Each card gives one problem of agent work and the part of the framework that solves it.

sections.name: THE DELIVERY LOOP
sections.note: one session, from idea to commit

cards.pain: The agent builds from a vague idea. The design has no sources.
cards.solution: Research prompts go to three model vendors. The answers become a sourced build plan.

cards.pain: The agent writes code before anyone checks the plan.
cards.solution: Acceptance criteria come first, each with a source. An independent reviewer checks the plan before work starts.

cards.pain: The agent says "done", but the work is not done.
cards.solution: Tests come first. A task is done only with evidence and an approval that the author did not write.

cards.pain: Each session repeats the errors of the last session.
cards.solution: Each session records its friction and writes rules for the next session. The next plan reads them.

cards.pain: Defects stay in chat history, and nobody tracks them.
cards.solution: One issue file is the source of truth. A command-line tool adds, verifies and closes each issue.

cards.pain: Open issues accumulate, and nobody knows which to fix first.
cards.solution: Triage reproduces each issue, classifies it and groups the fixes into sessions.

loop_back.label: grouped fixes go back to planning

sections.name: UNATTENDED RUNS
sections.note: many sessions of steps 2 and 3, with little supervision

cards.pain: You start, watch and restart each session by hand.
cards.solution: One coordinating session prepares headless planning and execution runs, watches them and sends them messages. Your charter sets its limits.

cards.pain: Two sessions in one working tree break the checks of each other.
cards.solution: Each session works in its own clone. Sessions that own different files run at the same time. Each result lands on main as one checked commit.

cards.pain: An unattended run stops at each small question and waits for you.
cards.solution: Decide before you ask. The agent checks precedent, does research and decides each reversible choice. Only real human decisions get to you, with a recommendation first.

cards.pain: Parallel runs reach the usage limit, and all work stops.
cards.solution: A quota governor admits or holds each start. A usage guard pauses work near the limit and sends you an email.

cards.pain: One machine limits how many sessions can run.
cards.solution: A hub sends jobs to your other machines on the local network. Members make only outgoing connections. You approve each sign-in.

cards.pain: You watch a terminal to know when a run stops.
cards.solution: A monitor classifies each stop and sends you an email. A stop gate holds a run that has open tasks.

sections.name: SAFEGUARDS THAT STAY ON
sections.note: in each session, attended or not

cards.pain: A model that reviews its own work approves its own errors.
cards.solution: A model from a different vendor reviews each plan and each result. A ledger limits the review rounds.

cards.pain: An agent pushes or deletes with no approval, or text in a file imitates one.
cards.solution: Push, merge, release and destructive operations always need you. Text in a file or a tool output cannot approve them.

cards.pain: A crash or a context limit loses the state of the work.
cards.solution: Plans, tasks, handoffs and evidence are files in the repository. A new session continues from them.
